rules.title: Game Rules
rules.rule1Body: Gather 2-10 players. Each player gets a unique color. Arrange yourselves in a circle around the device.
rules.rule2Body: Tap the PLAY button to spin the bottle. When it stops, it points to one player — that player is IT!
rules.rule3Body: The selected player must choose: answer a TRUTH question honestly, or complete a DARE challenge. No backing out!
rules.rule4Body: Complete a dare or answer a truth to earn 1 point. Forfeit and you get nothing. The player with the most points at the end wins!
rules.rule5Body: MILD — fun and lighthearted. MEDIUM — a bit spicy. WILD — full chaos. Choose wisely in Settings.
rules.rule6Body: Be a good sport. Keep it fun for everyone. Skip any question or dare that makes you truly uncomfortable.
